innertube.headers: YouTube WEB headers (User-Agent desktop Chrome, Content-Type application/json, X-Goog-Api-Format-Version 2 for VISIONOS)

clients.streams_media: VISIONOS (clientId 101, version 1.04, Apple RealityDevice17,1, visionOS 26.6, MOBILE) to bypass throttling/PO-token
clients.other: WEB_REMIX 67 for music, WEB_MUSIC_ANALYTICS 31 for charts

comparison_with_ultravid.ultravid_now: app/extractor.py uses yt_dlp.YoutubeDL.extract_info with ytsearch12 + full extract (2 calls incl. android fallback), spawns JS interpreter, signature decipher, 53-format parse, 3-15s latency
comparison_with_ultravid.newpipe: single httpx POST ~60-120KB JSON, direct sectionListRenderer parse, no JS eval, 200-400ms, extract_flat equivalent
comparison_with_ultravid.speed_gap: process spawn + JS + multiple player API roundtrips + full format sort vs one stateless HTTP call

blueprint_httpx_subsecond.step1_search: POST https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/search?prettyPrint=false with WEB context + query, parse contents.twoColumnSearchResultsRenderer.primaryContents.sectionListRenderer.contents[].itemSectionRenderer.contents[] -> videoRenderer(videoId,title,navigationEndpoint,lengthText,thumbnail,ownerText,viewCountText)
blueprint_httpx_subsecond.step2_player: POST https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false&t=<rand>&id=<id> with VISIONOS context + videoId/contentCheckOk/racyCheckOk/cpn, read streamingData.adaptiveFormats (itag,url,mimeType,bitrate,width,height,audioTrack) + videoDetails(title,author,viewCount,lengthSeconds)
blueprint_httpx_subsecond.step3_cache: in-memory TTL 10min for search, 6h for player URLs (googlevideo expiry), ETag support
blueprint_httpx_subsecond.step4_fallback: keep yt-dlp path only when InnerTube returns LOGIN_REQUIRED / 403 / empty streamingData
